note: Cookiebot CCPA variant: an OPT-OUT toggle "Do not sell and share my personal information" (currently off) + Confirm. Least data = switch it ON then Confirm. Hard: only the label variant can express "turn on". Labels: 'Confirm' (2) saves the panel that has an opt-out toggle, so 'save'. Hand-run of §2f: no reject; an opt-out toggle plus a save control means save-with-toggles (switch 3 on, then Confirm).
